about: The `report_anomalies` table, published whole. See /api/schema for its grain. This file is fy 2017 only.

rows.detail: Monty Tech's per-program enrollment split by gender for all twenty vocational programs is a complete dataset that exists ONLY as parentheticals at the end of prose paragraphs (p126-133) -- no heading, no table, invisible to any search for a table title.

rows.table: Receipts by revenue account for the year
rows.detail: The three columns interleave badly: a single extracted line often carries one account from each of the three columns (e.g. 'PERSONAL PROPERTY TAXES $714,783.71 RENTAL FEES CELL TOWER $36,125.94 NET METERING CREDITS $121,847.93').

rows.table: Special state primary and special state election results
rows.detail: Heavily OCR-damaged: precinct headers are missing or duplicated, several rows have fewer values than precincts, blanks and write-in rows are empty, and stray text ('TENSIS.', 'HOUSSYN') appears at the top.

rows.table: Monty Tech enrollment by vocational program and gender
rows.detail: This is a complete structured dataset hidden in prose, and no heading names it.

A named list of every person buried or cremated in the town cemeteries in 2017 (p50), with age, cemetery, cremation marker and the war each veteran served in. Meanwhile the vital records page (p152) explains that names of births, deaths and marriages have been REMOVED on the advice of the Registry of Vital Records -- so the same report both suppresses and publishes the identities of the dead.

The Special Services report (p102) gives out-of-district special education PLACEMENT COUNTS by type -- 14 students: 2 collaborative, 8 day, 4 residential, against 19 the prior year. That is the count the budget documents never publish, sitting in a narrative section of the town report.

Town Clock Winders is a formally appointed office with six named appointees (p13), alongside Pound Keeper, Fence Viewers (listed as 'Vacancies'), Field Driver, Dam Keeper and Assistant Dam Keeper, and seven Public Weighers appointed specifically for P.J. Keating Co.

Motor vehicle excise receivables are still being carried back to the levy of 2003, and personal property receivables back to the levy of 1998 (p43-44) -- a twenty-year uncollected tail listed year by year.

rows.table: Table of contents
rows.detail: This is also the index of which page numbers the report itself claims for each table -- useful as a cross-check that the PDF page number equals the printed page number (in FY2017 they match).

rows.table: New growth revenue, eight years
rows.detail: Also note the tax rates in this table are offset by one year against the Valuation and Tax History table above -- FY2017 new growth is shown at rate 19.61 (the FY2016 rate), which is either a lag convention or an error and should be checked against the source.

The report contains at least three internal figure disagreements that a reader would only find by cross-checking: the fire department's four call categories sum to 2143 against a stated 2107 (p79); PEG access revenue is $107,849.80 in one sentence and $107,889.80 two pages later (p68/p69); and Monty Tech's FY14 total expenditure is $24,785,280 on p142 and $24,785,240 on p143.

rows.table: School enrollment by grade, February 2018
rows.detail: Note this is a February 2018 count published in the FY2017 report, and it differs from the October 1 2017 count of 397 for the Primary School quoted on p106 and from the 1,628 total quoted in the Special Services report on p102.

A 20-year assessment history for all eighteen Monty Tech member towns (p149), transposed so towns are columns and in a non-alphabetical order that matches no other table in the report. Reading it by column position without checking the header assigns another town's history to Lunenburg.

Five of the report's biggest financial tables (capital project funds p34, trust funds p37-39, debt repayment schedule p41-42, receivables summary p43-45, Monty Tech balance sheet p140) come out of the text layer TRANSPOSED -- each column collapsed into one run-on line and the row labels stranded at the bottom. They look like data but the row-to-value mapping is gone entirely.
